digest.component_or_area: GitHub Code Quality remediation (CodeQL standard findings)
propositions: CodeQL identified 631 standard findings + 6 AI findings; 31 are mechanical, no-behavior-change fixes suitable for immediate remediation.
File-not-closed violations in _store/ensures.py, _io/export_ndjson.py, and tests require wrapping open() calls with context managers (with statement).
Unnecessary-lambda violations in audit/page.py and _snapshot/janitor.py require passing callables directly instead of wrapping in lambda.
Repeated-import violations in attest/opcert.py and llm/structured.py require removing redundant function-local re-imports.
Four AI test-cleanups remove unused local variables and split chained assertions in test_editor.py and test_validation_depth.py.
SIM115 linting rule was enabled in ruff configuration to prevent future file-not-closed violations across the codebase.
